QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_15

question.text: Which of the following statements about the Merchant Banker appointed for filing the PPM of Satpura Market-Neutral Fund is CORRECT?

answer.text: The Merchant Banker shall NOT be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.
The Merchant Banker may be an associate of the AIF's Sponsor to ensure cost efficiency.
The Merchant Banker is appointed only once at registration and is not required for subsequent PPM changes.
The Merchant Banker is chosen by SEBI from an empanelled list and the AIF has no say.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.7.1 explicitly says: 'The Merchant Banker appointed for filing of placement memorandum shall not be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.' This protects arm's-length due diligence. The Trap: Option B inverts the rule. Option C is wrong because, while some specific PPM-term changes may be filed directly with SEBI (page 100), other PPM changes are intimated through a Merchant Banker on a consolidated basis within 1 month of FY end (page 241) — so the blanket 'not required for subsequent PPM changes' statement is incorrect. Option D is fabricated. Note: Pages 100 and 241 of the workbook set out the merchant-banker independence rule and the consolidated PPM-change intimation route.
